name: salesmessage
description: Salesmessage web app as the ADMIN — session comes from profile/ (Google SSO)
//blockUrls: kept from loading during a take: the Intercom 'Welcome to Salesmsg' popup covers the permission checkboxes
//hideSelectors: hidden with CSS during a take: app banners (Aircall disconnected, notifications blocked) that sit across the top of every frame
//auth: The admin signs in with Google SSO, which the driver cannot fill. mode 'none' means: use whatever session profile/ already holds. Sign in to app.salesmessage.com once by hand in that profile; takes never log it out.
//secrets: internal ids kept out of the repo: a script writes open /settings/members/{memberId}/... (or start: /chatbot/{agentId}/config) and the driver fills it in. Set SALESMSG_DEMO_MEMBER_ID and SALESMSG_DEMO_AGENT_ID in .env.
